steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the LED starts blinking.

verification.note: Assumed from the SET button linking used across Insteon devices; no document describes this product's.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the LED starts blinking.
Have the Hub start ALL-Linking as the responder.
steps.expect: The Hub reports ALL-Linking Completed with the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: Have the Hub send ID Request.
steps.expect: The device answers with its category, subcategory and firmware version

steps.text: While the device is still awake, have the Hub send Ping to confirm the link.

notes: Put the device in linking mode before the Hub starts ALL-Linking. This links the device to the Hub as a controller, with the Hub as the responder, so the Hub receives the device's reports; the Hub makes no link to the device.

verification.note: Assembled from this profile's linking steps and the standard Insteon commands Start ALL-Linking, ID Request and Ping; no document describes adding this product to a Hub.

steps.text: Remove the device from every scene.

verification.note: Read from how Insteon links work: a device left in a scene keeps links to it in other devices' ALL-Link databases. No document describes removing this product.

steps.text: Remove the device from its scenes first, so no other device keeps links to it.
Press and hold the SET button for 5 seconds.
Press and hold the SET button for 5 seconds again.
Have the Hub start ALL-Linking with link code 0xFF (delete), so the device deletes its group 1 link to the Hub.
steps.expect: The device deletes its group 1 link to the Hub, and the Hub reports the device's Insteon ID

verification.note: Assembled from the standard Insteon command Start ALL-Linking; no document describes removing this product from a Hub. The unlinking steps are assumed from the Motion Sensor 2842 profile's; no document describes this product's.
